settings.question: Will it put a hole in my sweater?
settings.answer: Not when used as directed. The guard is rigid, so it doesn't flex into the fabric. Use the higher setting on fine knits, glide without pressing, keep the fabric flat.

settings.question: Does it work on cashmere and merino?
settings.answer: Yes. Use the [higher] setting and light, small circles. Test on an inside seam first.

settings.question: Can I use it on my couch?
settings.answer: Yes, on most woven and knit upholstery. Avoid leather, velvet and anything with a raised pile.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: About [90 minutes] per charge. Charges with any USB-C cable in about [2 hours].

settings.question: How often do I replace the blades?
settings.answer: About every [6 months] with regular use. Refills are $19 for two.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders before [2pm ET] on business days ship [the same day]. US delivery takes [3–5] business days.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the US?
settings.answer: [Not yet. We ship to all 50 states.]

settings.question: Is there a warranty?
settings.answer: [1 year against defects.] Email us with your order number and a photo.
